cards.name: Ryu-kishin
cards.description: A very elusive creature that looks like a harmless statue until it attacks.

cards.name: Feral Imp
cards.description: A playful little imp that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.

cards.name: Summoned Skull
cards.description: An entity with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the FIEND class of monsters, this is a pretty rare card.

cards.name: Horn Imp
cards.description: A small imp that dwells in the dark. Its single horn makes it a formidable opponent.

cards.name: Sangan
cards.description: A compact, three-eyed monster that is dangerous when faced in the dark.

cards.name: Kuriboh
cards.description: By itself, this creature may not seem like much. But in the dark, it attacks in numbers as a formidable force.

cards.name: Castle of Dark Illusions
cards.description: A creature that can generate darkness to envelop all that exists around it.

cards.name: Reaper of the Cards
cards.description: This monster boasts a strong defense and massive scythe that cuts through almost anything.

cards.name: King of Yamimakai
cards.description: Wields the power of darkness to destroy its enemies.

cards.name: Barox
cards.description: This creature flies through the dark, attacking its enemies with its long hairy arms.

cards.name: Dark Chimera
cards.description: A fire-breathing monster that dwells in the netherworld.

cards.name: Metal Guardian
cards.description: A fiend guarding the treasure of the netherworld. Its defense is particularly high in a dark environment.

cards.name: Crass Clown
cards.description: A performer in the dark circus, this clown drains the strength of its enemies with strange dances.

cards.name: Mask of Darkness
cards.description: A shadow mask created by the hands of a dark mage.

cards.name: Job-Change Mirror
cards.description: An indestructible, wicked mirror that blocks enemy attacks.

cards.name: That Which Feeds on Life
cards.description: A vile monster that fuels it power by draining the essence of life from its opponents.

cards.name: Trial of Nightmares
cards.description: Passes judgment on enemies that are locked in coffins.

cards.name: Witty Phantom
cards.description: Dressed in a night-black tuxedo, this creature presides over the doomed.

cards.name: Mystery Hand
cards.description: Twisting the fabric of reality, arms stretch out from another dimension to attack opponents.

cards.name: The Shadow Who Controls the Dark
cards.description: A living shadow that dwells in the realm of darkness. It paralyzes its enemies to prevent attacks.

cards.name: Lord of the Lamp
cards.description: A giant that appears from a mystic lamp and follows the orders of the lamp's owner.

cards.name: Tainted Wisdom
cards.description: A parasite brain that preys on the knowledge and intelligence of its opponents.

cards.name: Lord of Zemia
cards.description: A vile entity that deceives enemies into walking the path of destruction

cards.name: Dark King of the Abyss
cards.description: King of the netherworld. It's said that he once had the power to rule over the dark.

cards.name: Big Eye
cards.description: This creature is covered with hypnotic eyes for mesmerizing its enemies.

cards.name: Dark Prisoner
cards.description: This creature manipulates light to eliminate all traces of its appearance.

cards.name: Ancient Brain
cards.description: Exiled from reality, this creature is adept at fighting in the dark.

cards.name: Claw Reacher
cards.description: Stretching arms and razor-sharp claws make this monster a formidable opponent.

cards.name: Dark Shade
cards.description: Emits a dazzling light from its crystal to blind its enemies.

cards.name: Terra the Terrible
cards.description: Know as a dweller of the swamps, this creature is a minion of the dark forces.

cards.name: Mabarrel
cards.description: A cannon-like monster that rapidly fires eyeballs at the enemy.

cards.name: Midnight Fiend
cards.description: A winged creature rumored to appear at midnight.

cards.name: Madjinn Gunn
cards.description: A living weapon that fires projectiles from its mouth.

cards.name: Dark Titan of Terror
cards.description: A spirit said to dwell in the world of dreams. Attacks enemies in their sleep.

cards.name: The Drdek
cards.description: An eyeball creature with legs for jumping high and delivering finishing blows with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Candle of Fate
cards.description: An opponent's fate is decided when the flames of each finger are extinguished.

cards.name: Meda Bat
cards.description: An eyeball fiend created by a servant of darkness. Uses "Dark Spheres" to blow away its enemies.

cards.name: Embryonic Beast
cards.description: A repulsive monster with a gaping belly that swallows almost anything.

cards.name: Wicked Mirror
cards.description: A malevolent mirror that hypnotizes a beholder and renders the victim susceptible to attacks.

cards.name: Versago the Destroyer
cards.description: A lord of destruction born from the heart of darkness, this creature can summon storms to destroy opponents.

cards.name: Megirus Light
cards.description: This creature's ominous eyes can unleash piercing rays against its enemies.

cards.name: Gorgon Egg
cards.description: A gorgon's egg with eyes said to create whatever creature crosses its view.

cards.name: King Fog
cards.description: A specter that dwells in a blinding curtain of smoke.

cards.name: Mystic Clown
cards.description: Nothing can stop the mad attack of this powerful creature.

cards.name: Dark Artist
cards.description: A demented artist that creates objects d'art to crunch enemies.

cards.name: Bio Plant
cards.description: A monstrous creature born from failed lab experiment.

cards.name: Ryu-kishin Powered
cards.description: Ryu-kishin enhanced by the power of darkness. Very sharp talons make it a worthy opponent.

cards.name: La Jinn the Mystical Genie
cards.description: A genie of the lamp that's at the beck and call of its master.

cards.name: Bickuribox
cards.description: A jack-in-the-box that excels in surprise attacks.

cards.name: Zoa
cards.description: A monster whose full potential can be achieved when transformed in to its metal form.

cards.name: Ushi Oni
cards.description: A bull monster resurrected by the dark arts that appears from inside a jar.

cards.name: Monster Eye
cards.description: A servant that maintains a close watch on anything and everything. It throws up a smokescreen when discovered.

cards.name: Soul Hunter
cards.description: This clown feeds the life force of its enemies to a monstrous lizard.

cards.name: Air Eater
cards.description: A monster that suffocates its enemy by feeding on the surrounding air supply.

cards.name: Needle Ball
cards.description: A ball covered in sharp needles. Usually rains down on enemies in a group.

cards.name: Morinphen
cards.description: A strange fiend with long arms and razor-sharp talons.

cards.name: Dragon Seeker
cards.description: A fearsome monster sent from the netherworld to destroy dragons.

cards.name: Fungi of the Musk
cards.description: A monster that leaks acid from its pores to melt anything that touches its skin.

cards.name: The Bistro Butcher
cards.description: Defeated enemies served as ingredients for this gourmet monster.

cards.name: Neck Hunter
cards.description: Armed with a huge sickle, this monster can fire beams from its large eyes.

cards.name: Invader from Another Dimension
cards.description: A creature that came from another galaxy.

cards.name: Wretched Ghost of the Attic
cards.description: A harmless creature usually found in the attic of any home.

cards.name: Key Mace #2
cards.description: Seals away the good in a soul to create a wicked being.

cards.name: Hiro's Shadow Scout
cards.description: A servant of fiends used primarily for scouting an area.

cards.name: Whiptail Crow
cards.description: Attacks from the skies with a whip-like tail.
